title: Aggregate and Triage Scan Results
objective: Consolidate all raw scan data, deduplicate findings, and categorize vulnerabilities by type and severity.
rationale: Raw scan data is often redundant and overwhelming; this task filters noise and creates a single, manageable list of unique vulnerabilities.
expected_output: A consolidated vulnerability matrix listing unique CVEs, their associated severity (CVSS score), and the affected component.
success_criteria: All raw scan results are successfully parsed and merged.
Duplicate findings are identified and merged into single entries.
The matrix includes a clear severity rating for every identified vulnerability.
